correctness.rationale: The full proof partitions every factor by one, two, three, or four maximal runs. Closed one-run words are powers, two-run words lack nonempty borders, the only closed three-run words have equal outer run lengths, and a four-run factor is closed iff its initial-zero and final-one lengths fit both repeated 01 transitions. Disjoint family counting yields n+1+min(a,c)min(b,d). Every positive product pq with 2(p+q)≤n is realized by an explicit four-part composition, and balancing p+q maximizes pq. Independent direct-border exhaustive enumeration verified actual factor sets for all 1296 parameter quadruples with a,b,c,d≤6 and complete spectra at n=4..18; finite checking is not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Binary CR-poor/bitonic words are exactly the minimum closed-factor class. Four nonempty runs (three changes) are the first genuinely non-bitonic class, making their exact defect the natural first sharp boundary question. The result classifies every closed factor, yields an all-parameter multiplicative defect, and determines the complete non-interval fixed-length spectrum and sharp constrained quadratic optimum, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. It refines a previously used four-block quadratic-existence construction by determining all its factors and best possible behavior.
